instruction: Go to View > Notes on the first slide and enter 'Introduction to multimedia classroom podium controls and basic operations.' in the notes area.

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(1)

rules.expected_notes: Introduction to multimedia classroom podium controls and basic operations.

metadata.explanation: Task requires adding specific notes text to slide 1. Custom getter downloads PPTX file and extracts notes, custom metric compares against expected text. Added postconfig to save the file before evaluation.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement: adding specific notes text to the first slide
Getter logic is correct: downloads PPTX file from VM filesystem using env.controller.get_file()
Metric logic is correct: extracts notes from slide 0 using notes_slide.notes_text_frame.text and compares against expected text
Expected parameter handling is correct: uses expected.get('slide_idx') and expected.get('expected_notes') directly since expected.type='rule' returns rules dict
Postconfig appropriately saves the file (Ctrl+S) before evaluation to ensure changes are persisted
Edge cases handled: checks for out-of-range slide index and missing notes_slide (returns empty string)
Comparison logic appropriate: uses exact text match with whitespace stripping, suitable for verifying specific text content
Complete coverage: evaluator verifies the exact requirement from the instruction (notes text on first slide)
